about: Groove template vectors (docs/08-phase-7.md, "Grooves"): Anode.Model's Grooves computes these; the server and the editor must reproduce them exactly (velocity scales to 1e-12). Ticks: 960 per quarter note. EXTRACTION (`extract`: onsets in project ticks with strengths 0…1, from startTick, lengthTicks, stepTicks; lengthTicks a positive multiple of stepTicks, N = lengthTicks / stepTicks points): step n's grid tick is g = startTick + n * stepTicks and it holds the onsets with g - step/2 <= tick < g + step/2 (exactly: n = floor((2 * (tick - startTick) + step) / (2 * step)), onsets with n outside 0…N-1 are ignored). Its winner is the strongest; ties go to the nearer the grid, then the earlier. Point n is (winner.tick - startTick, winner.strength / S), S the greatest winner strength; a step without onsets, or every step when S = 0, is (n * stepTicks, 1). From notes (`fromNotes`: notes relative to the region's start startTick): each note is an onset at startTick + note.startTick with strength velocity / 127. From audio the server turns GrooveFromAudio onsets (frames, strengths) into project ticks with the tempo map first. TARGET (`targets`: tick, strength): t <= 0 is step k = 0, else k = floor((2t + step - 1) / (2 * step)) (the nearest multiple of stepTicks; a tie goes to the earlier); n = k mod N, cycle c = floor(k / N); the landing is L = c * lengthTicks + points[n].tick (the template repeats from the project start); the result is max(0, t + round((L - t) * strength)) (rounded half away from zero; never before the project start) and points[n].velocityScale. QUANTIZE (`quantize`: notes relative to regionStartTick): each note's project tick is regionStartTick + startTick; its new startTick is target.tick - regionStartTick (not clamped to the region); with velocity, its velocity v becomes round(v * (1 + strength * (scale - 1))) half away from zero, clamped to 1…127; other fields and the order stay.
